_why: ACCESS1h (D284): what the connector lists, every tool the host registers against every work its session can be placed in. Every column is served every registered tool, a subagent's call being its session's own: the connector refuses nothing by who calls, and a tool whose work has nothing to act on says so in its own answer. McpRoleFilterTests holds the file to the host's registration and to the closed set of works, a brainstorm placed by its two turns, so a tool added later is listed to every work and a work added later is named here. The driver's one-job permission postures (PartnerPermissions.Offered, OpinionPermissions.Offered, SupervisePermissions.Offered) are the harness's rules for those sessions, set by their start and never by this table.
